content: Official pytest documentation states that fixtures provide defined reliable test context and that pytest.mark.parametrize runs one test over multiple argument sets. For this phase, instantiate a fresh scratchpad per unit test and parametrize exact boundary and malformed-input cases. Sources: https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/explanation/fixtures.html and https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/how-to/parametrize.html
